name: Carly Chancol
source:
Senior-Renden High School

A high-spirited, uninhibited girl who is always full of energy. Generally injects optimism and good vibes into every situation.

Confident and flirty, she knows what she wants and goes after it or tries to, anyways.

After meeting Siona, she is determined to make the most of their friendship and can be a little clingy at times.

From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2771560/Zeta_Wolf_First_Bite/]Steam[/url]
